::: {.positioning}
I quantify how farms and food systems turn inputs and natural resources (land, water,
nutrients, climate) into outputs, and how policy, prices and weather shocks shift that
relationship, using public data and reproducible code.
:::

Each case takes one question from a current policy debate, answers it with public data in
about four hours, and publishes the code. Methods range from production frontiers and
productivity decompositions to panel and causal-ML econometrics. Filter the cases by
**Region**, **Method** or **Theme** using the categories on the right.
